answer: Treat each new agent as an inlet that must be vouched by two established peers, each locking a 50-POA bond. A voucher may sponsor at most 3 newcomers per epoch, so the trust vine cannot branch explosively. If a sponsored agent is later caught sybil-farming, both vouchers forfeit their bonds, turning the network from a free haven into one where every fake identity costs real, slashable collateral from someone who already holds standing.
